lineage.transformation_summary: Native cross-domain scientific-entry method packaged as an installable derivative of the shared capability prototype.

capability_value.retention_rule: Retain as an extension only if bounded cross-domain entry improves problem framing and admission without overstating domain authority.

admission.retirement_condition: Retire if search, domain admission, human learning, retention, and result claims can no longer be evaluated separately.

authority.source: User-supplied sources, named domain authorities, and explicit version boundaries remain authoritative.
authority.candidate: Case maps, candidates, admission judgments, and capability claims remain candidate-only until separately reviewed.
authority.confirmation: Human confirmation and the named domain admission route are required before durable writeback or public claims.
authority.save_target: Use the existing answer, artifact, or Review flow; this extension owns no storage or release authority.

en.name: Cross-domain scientific entry
en.goal: Turn entry into an unfamiliar scientific domain into a bounded, replayable process that separates search, admission, human learning, system retention, and domain results.
en.user_input_hint: Provide the target domain, one local problem or phenomenon, the smallest source set, evidence obligation, budget, and available domain-admission route.
en.output: Case Charter + Minimum Domain Map + Approach Registry + Candidate Ledger + Admission Receipt + Retention/Transfer Report + Case Settlement
next_steps: Compare at most three candidate cases and freeze one
Verify the problem status and evidence obligation before solution search
Choose answer, Case Pack artifact, or candidate writeback through Review

zh-CN.name: 跨域科研入域
zh-CN.goal: 把进入陌生科学领域变成一个有边界、可回放的过程，并分开检验搜索、准入、人的学习、系统保持和领域结果。
zh-CN.user_input_hint: 提供目标领域、一个局部问题或现象、最小来源集、证据义务、预算和可用的领域准入入口。
zh-CN.output: Case Charter + Minimum Domain Map + Approach Registry + Candidate Ledger + Admission Receipt + Retention/Transfer Report + Case Settlement
next_steps: 最多比较三个候选案例并只冻结一个
解题搜索前核对问题状态和证据义务
选择直接回答、Case Pack 产物或经 Review 的候选写回
